description_en: Starts a specified Program View (PVW) scene. This operation is used to start preview scenes
description_zh: 启动指定场景，限制仅用于PVW的打开
name: StartCasterScene

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the CasterId value returned in the response.

If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio page to view the ID.

The production studio ID is displayed as its name on the Cloud Production Studio page
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the scene.

This parameter is valid only for PVW scenes
parameters.help_zh:
场景ID。

只有是PVW场景时才可用
parameters.name: scene_id

StreamUrl.description_en: The output stream URL of the current scene. This URL is used for playback in the production studio and is not a bypass output
StreamUrl.description_zh: 当前场景的输出流地址。用于导播台播放，非旁路输出
